name: carry_idle
action: standing idle while hugging the small dog against her chest with both arms wrapped around it, gentle breathing, the dog wags its tail, staying in place

name: carry_walk
action: walk cycle in place facing right while carrying the small dog in her arms against her chest, both arms wrapped around the dog, steady steps, loopable

name: carry_kick
action: keeps hugging the small dog with both arms and does a quick front kick to the right with her leg fully extended at waist height, then returns to standing
